description: This file defines interfaces for controller-related functionalities within the WPEFramework, including system management, discovery, configuration, lifecycle, and metadata. It declares several pure virtual classes and their methods, which are meant to be implemented elsewhere. The file also contains licensing information and namespace organization.
external_methods: Core::hresult Clone(const string& callsign, const string& newcallsign, string& response)
Core::hresult Environment(const string& index, string& environment) const
Core::hresult Configuration(const string& callsign, string& configuration) const
Core::hresult Configuration(const string& callsign, const string& configuration)
Core::hresult Hibernate(const string& callsign, const Core::hresult timeout)
Core::hresult Status(const string& index, string& response)
Core::hresult CallStack(const string& index, string& callstack)

classes.name: ISystemManagement
classes.description: Interface for system management operations such as reboot, delete, clone, and environment variable retrieval.

classes.name: IDiscovery
classes.description: Interface for network discovery operations, including starting discovery and retrieving results.

classes.name: IConfiguration
classes.description: Interface for configuration management, including persisting configuration and retrieving specific configuration values.

classes.name: ILifeTime
classes.description: Interface for controlling plugin lifecycle states and notifications about state changes.

classes.name: ILifeTime::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for plugin state changes, used to notify clients of lifecycle events.

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface for retrieving metadata information such as proxies, status, links, process info, subsystems, version, and call stack.

methods.name: Reboot
methods.description: Reboots the device.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes contents of a directory from persistent storage.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of a plugin with a new callsign.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Provides the value of a request environment variable.

methods.name: StartDiscovery
methods.description: Initiates SSDP network discovery with a specified TTL.

methods.name: DiscoveryResults
methods.description: Retrieves SSDP network discovery results.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Stores the current configuration to persistent memory.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Retrieves or sets configuration values for a specific callsign.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a sink for lifecycle notifications.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a sink from lifecycle notifications.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates a specified plugin.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates a specified plugin.

methods.name: Unavailable
methods.description: Marks a plugin as unavailable for interaction.

methods.name: Hibernate
methods.description: Sets a plugin into Hibernate state with an optional timeout.

methods.name: Suspend
methods.description: Suspends a plugin.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes a suspended plugin.

methods.name: Proxies
methods.description: Provides details about current proxies.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Provides status of a plugin including configurations.

methods.name: Links
methods.description: Provides details about active connections.

methods.name: ProcessInfo
methods.description: Provides framework process information.

methods.name: Subsystems
methods.description: Provides details about active subsystems.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Provides version information of WPEFramework.

methods.name: CallStack
methods.description: Provides callstack information for a given thread index.

calls: Core::hresult Clone(const string& callsign, const string& newcallsign, string& response)
Core::hresult Environment(const string& index, string& environment) const
